Current OpenAI Agents SDK states that interruption updates history to stay aligned with what the user actually heard and recommends a playback tracker for delayed playback so truncation uses actual playback position.
Current LiveKit voice-agent interruption handling truncates conversation history to only the portion of agent speech the user heard before interruption.
